bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 3
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Apron, CSN3121, request medical assistance and a wheelchair, we have an elderly passenger feeling unwell.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3121, Apron, roger, medical staff will meet you at the stand.

questions.question: What service does CSN3121 need?
questions.explanation: 飞行员明确请求 "request medical assistance and a wheelchair"，因为有老年乘客身体不适，管制员也回复 "medical staff will meet you at the stand"，故选 A。其余选项（配餐、机务、加油）对话中均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL791, Wuhan Ground, taxi via K, T2 and S to holding point of RWY36L.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Taxi via K, T2 and S to holding point, RWY36L, JAL791.

questions.question: How should JAL791 taxi?

options.A: K, T2, S to holding point, RWY36R
options.B: K2, T, S to holding point, RWY36L
options.C: K, T2, S to holding point, RWY36L
options.D: T2, K, S to holding point, RWY36R

questions.explanation: 管制员指令 "taxi via K, T2 and S to holding point of RWY36L"，飞行员复述一致。正确滑行路线为 K、T2、S 且跑道是 36L，故选 C；A、D 跑道号错为 36R，B 把 K、T2 误写为 K2、T。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Control, CCA1732, we have lost one hydraulic system, the landing gear has to be extended manually, request priority landing.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1732, Control, roger PANPAN, say your intentions.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Request straight-in approach, CCA1732.

questions.question: Why is CCA1732 making an urgency call?

options.A: Because the landing gear is on fire.
options.C: Because of a hydraulic system failure.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 PANPAN 并说明 "we have lost one hydraulic system, the landing gear has to be extended manually"，即液压系统失效，故选 C。起落架起火、失压、乘客病危均与原文不符。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5302, Wuhan Control, follow KG-11A Arrival, expect ILS approach RWY36R, descend to 3000m on QNH1012, Info T.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, KG-01A Arrival, ILS approach RWY36R, CES5302.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5302, negative, KG-11A Arrival, descend to 3000m on QNH1012, Info T.

questions.question: What mistake did the pilot make during the readback?

options.A: The pilot was wrong about the altitude and missed the Arrival procedure.
options.B: The pilot was wrong about the Arrival procedure and missed altitude and Info.
options.C: The pilot was wrong about the runway and missed Info.
options.D: The pilot was wrong about the callsign and missed altitude.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令为 "KG-11A Arrival"，飞行员却复述成 "KG-01A Arrival"，进场程序号读错；同时复述中漏掉了 "descend to 3000m" 和 "Info T"。管制员随后纠正 "negative, KG-11A Arrival"。故选 B，其余选项所指的错误类型与原文不符。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, DLH3025, we have traffic indication at 3 o'clock, 6nm, 400m below us, it's climbing rapidly, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: DLH3025, it's a military trainer aircraft, maintain 5700m, reduce speed to 260 knots.

questions.question: Where is the military aircraft?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 "traffic indication at 3 o'clock, 6nm, 400m below us, it's climbing rapidly"，与选项 A 完全一致。B 距离错（16nm），C 方位和垂直运动错，D 高度关系错（above）。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CHH7789, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CHH7789, cleared for takeoff, RWY05L, surface wind 340 degrees 8m/s gusting to 18m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 121.1.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 121.1, CHH7789.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CHH7789, 500m climbing. The landing gear fails to retract, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CHH7789, roger, continue runway heading, turn left after 800m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue runway heading, turn left after 800m, request a long final to check the gear, CHH7789.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CHH7789, contact Approach 127.75.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 127.75, thanks, CHH7789.

questions.question: What is the wind condition when CHH7789 takes off?
questions.explanation: 起飞指令中塔台通报 "surface wind 340 degrees 8m/s gusting to 18m/s"，阵风达 18m/s，属于阵风（gusting wind）条件，故选 D。

questions.question: What happened to CHH7789 during takeoff?
questions.explanation: 起飞后飞行员报告 "The landing gear fails to retract, request return to land"，即起落架无法收上，故选 B。鸟击、爆胎、发动机失效对话中均未发生。

questions.question: Which frequency should CHH7789 call finally?
questions.explanation: 对话最后管制员指令 "contact Approach 127.75"，飞行员复述 "Approach 127.75"，故最终应联系的频率是 127.75，选 B。121.1 是起飞后联系 Departure 的频率，并非最后指令。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4109, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 5nm right of track, expect rejoin the route at TM.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 5nm right of track, CCA4109.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CCA4109, we have weather indication 20nm ahead of us, request deviate to the right for 10nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4109, negative due to danger area, can you accept deviation to the left?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 060 for 25nm, CCA4109.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4109, turn left heading 060, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Left heading 060, wilco, CCA4109.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CCA4109, we have rapid decompression, oxygen masks have deployed. We are emergency descending to 3000m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4109, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between TM and WHA, all aircraft below 9000m, leave the route to the north.

questions.question: How can CCA4109 avoid the weather according to the pilot?

options.A: Deviate to the left side for 25nm.
options.C: Deviate to the right side for 20nm.
options.D: Deviate to the right side for 10nm.

questions.explanation: 飞行员申请 "request deviate to the right for 10nm"，即向右偏航 10 海里绕天气，故选 D。注意管制员因危险区未批准右偏，但题目问的是按飞行员的想法；20nm 是天气距离，25nm 是后来左转 060 的航程。

questions.question: Why can't CCA4109 detour the weather from the right side?

options.A: Because there is a prohibited area.
options.C: Because there is a danger area.
options.D: Because there is a restricted area.

questions.explanation: 管制员拒绝右偏时明确说明 "negative due to danger area"，即右侧有危险区，故选 C。禁区（prohibited area）、限制区（restricted area）、军事活动均未提及。

questions.question: What happened to CCA4109?
questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 MAYDAY 并报告 "we have rapid decompression, oxygen masks have deployed"，即快速失压，故选 A。雷击、发动机失火、漏油均与原文不符。

questions.question: Where is CCA4109 when he started emergency descent?

options.A: North of TM and WHA at 3000m.

questions.explanation: 管制员在全台通告中说 "emergency descent between TM and WHA"，且飞行员报告 "emergency descending to 3000m"，即开始紧急下降时在 TM 与 WHA 之间、目标高度 3000m，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CSN6601, 10nm final, established ILS, RWY36.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6601, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 160kts, report outer marker.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 160kts, report outer marker, CSN6601.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6601, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36, wind 020, 9m/s, gusting up to 17m/s. QNH1021.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36, QNH1021, thanks, CSN6601.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN6601, we had a nose wheel steering failure after landing, the aircraft is stuck on the runway. Unable to vacate runway, request a tug to tow us back.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6601, roger, tug is on the way. Break Break. AFR997, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied due to aircraft unable to vacate.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, AFR997.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, AFR997, a passenger was scalded by hot drinks during the missed approach, request medical assistance upon arrival.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR997, roger, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.4.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 119.4, AFR997.

questions.question: Why is CSN6601 unable to vacate the runway?

options.B: The runway was blocked by vehicles.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 "we had a nose wheel steering failure after landing, the aircraft is stuck on the runway"，即前轮转弯（转向）失效，故选 D。主起落架折断、刹车失效等未提及。

questions.question: What was the consequence of CSN6601's problem?

options.A: The aircraft was stuck on the runway and unable to taxi.
options.B: The aircraft skidded off the runway.

questions.explanation: 飞行员明确说 "the aircraft is stuck on the runway. Unable to vacate runway"，即飞机卡在跑道上无法脱离，故选 A。冲出跑道、起火均不符；乘客烫伤发生在 AFR997 上，不是 CSN6601 的后果。

questions.question: What was AFR997's request after the missed approach?
questions.explanation: 复飞后 AFR997 报告 "a passenger was scalded by hot drinks during the missed approach, request medical assistance upon arrival"，即请求医疗援助，故选 C。请求拖车的是 CSN6601。
